Uses Formspree — free, no server needed. Takes 2 minutes to set up.

SETUP (one time)
1. Go to formspree.io and create a free account
2. Click + New Form → name it "Bundle Orders" → set your email
3. Copy the Form ID (the short code after formspree.io/f/)
4. Paste it below and click Save

Accessibility Statement
Last updated: September 2026

Digital 1 Music is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually improve the user experience for everyone and apply relevant accessibility standards.

Conformance Status

We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible to people with disabilities.

Measures We Take
  • Include accessibility as part of our design and development process
  • Provide text alternatives for non-text content including album artwork and images
  • Ensure sufficient color contrast across the site
  • Support keyboard navigation throughout the site
  • Ensure audio and video content is labeled appropriately
  • Maintain a consistent and clear navigation structure
Known Limitations

We are actively working to improve accessibility including audio players and embedded media content. If you experience any difficulty, please contact us directly.

Feedback & Contact

We welcome your feedback. Please use the to reach us with any accessibility concerns.

Assessment Approach

Digital 1 Music assesses the accessibility of this website through self-evaluation and ongoing review.

Accessibility Statement

Digital 1 Music is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually improve the user experience for everyone and apply relevant accessibility standards.

Conformance Status

We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible to people with disabilities.

Measures We Take
  • Include accessibility as part of our design and development process
  • Provide text alternatives for non-text content including album artwork and images
  • Ensure sufficient color contrast across the site
  • Support keyboard navigation throughout the site
  • Ensure audio and video content is labeled appropriately
  • Maintain a consistent and clear navigation structure
Known Limitations

We are aware that some areas of our site may not yet fully meet accessibility standards. We are actively working to improve these areas, including audio players and embedded media content. If you experience any difficulty, please contact us directly for assistance.
